name: Truthiness alone does not narrow a binding type

input.fixture_ref: A Dynamic<Object> binding is truth-tested and then used where a narrowed type would be required.

applicability.reason: Requires flow-sensitive STATIC type analysis, confirmed by measurement. C042 says a conditional test MUST NOT retype the tested operand: arbitrary `to_bool` is not a type predicate. That is a claim about the binding's static Type, not about what runs. Probing shows why no runtime observation reaches it: `let x: Dynamic<Object> = 1; if x { x }` evaluates to 1 whether or not the analyser retyped x, because the value is the same either way. Distinguishing the two needs the analyser to carry expression Types and report a narrowed use as a diagnostic, which it does not do. This is the same missing subsystem TYPES-V920 and TYPES-V208 name.

expect.status: The truthiness test does not retype the binding.
